sloka: कच्चित् ते कुशलम् राजन् कच्चित् धर्मेण रंजयन् ।प्रजाः पालयसे राजन् राज वृत्तेन धार्मिक ॥१-५२-७॥
transliteration: kaccit te kuśalam rājan kaccit dharmeṇa raṁjayan ।prajāḥ pālayase rājan rāja vṛttena dhārmika ॥1-52-7॥

translations.english: "O King, is it all well with you? O righteous one O heroic one are you ruling (your subjects) in accordance with the duties enjoined upon the king? Do you rule them in conformity with the code of moralit in order to make them happy.
